text: Cursor for the plan, Aider for the diffs. Export the chat to markdown and pass it to Aider as --read.
HttpClient throws TaskCanceledException for three different reasons. Check ex.InnerException is TimeoutException before you raise any timeout.
Stop pasting team conventions into Copilot Chat. A SKILL.md in .github/skills loads only when the prompt matches.
Flutter M3 has no accentColor. ColorScheme.fromSeed is the one knob. Pick fidelity if your brand must render literally.
await is not parallelism. Isolate.run for one-shot CPU work, Isolate.spawn for warm workers. On web, neither runs.
MAUI 11 drag-and-drop in one line: DataPackage.Properties is process-local. Set e.Data.Text too if the drop crosses apps.
MAUI dark mode that actually flips: AppThemeBinding plus ConfigChanges.UiMode on MainActivity. Without the flag, Android only switches once.
Cursor just shipped a TypeScript SDK. Same Composer agent as the editor, runs against your cwd or a sandboxed cloud VM.
MAUI to the Microsoft Store: dotnet publish per arch, MakeAppx bundle, zip as .msixupload. The VS wizard still won't.
byte[] to ReadOnlyMemory<byte> in .NET 11: implicit cast for the full array, AsMemory(start, length) for a slice.
One Flutter repo, many SDK versions in CI: .fvmrc as truth, a fail-fast:false matrix on subosito/flutter-action v2.
Claude Code 2.1.128: --plugin-dir takes .zip archives, EnterWorktree branches from local HEAD, OTEL_* no longer leaks to subprocesses.
GetConnectionString returns null in .NET 11? Usually appsettings.json key missing or not copied to bin, not your code.
Expose EF Core to a coding agent via MCP, not a RunQuery(sql) tool. IDbContextFactory, AsNoTracking, gated writes.
Skip the federated plugin scaffold. A MethodChannel plus 20 lines in MainActivity / AppDelegate is the whole bridge.
Agent Framework 1.0: wrap an AIFunction in ApprovalRequiredAIFunction and the agent pauses for a human first.
Migrating Flutter from GetX to Riverpod 3.x: GetxController to Notifier, .obs to providers, Get.find to ref.watch.
Semantic Kernel 1.75 in a BackgroundService: scope per tick, or your scoped DbContext disposes mid-loop.
Flutter jank: profile mode, real device, Frame Analysis. Red on UI = your Dart code. Red on raster = shaders or saveLayer.
Agent Framework workflows now checkpoint per executor. Microsoft.Agents.AI.DurableTask + Azure Functions = restart-safe runs.
ListView to CollectionView in MAUI 11: no CachingStrategy, RefreshView wraps it, SwipeView replaces ContextActions.
EF Core's 'another instance with the same key value is already being tracked' usually means your DbContext is Singleton.
EF Core 'second operation was started on this context' means two awaits raced one DbContext. Fix: IDbContextFactory.
Copilot Studio's WASM engine moved to .NET 10: ~20% faster cold path, ~5% warm, +15% package. Why the tradeoff is worth it.
Keep Playwright's 25 browser_* tools out of your main Claude Code session. One subagent owns them, parent stays lean.
System.Text.Json only takes ISO 8601 for DateTime. Send 2026-05-08T14:00:00Z or register a JsonConverter.
Copilot dropped claude-sonnet-4 May 6 across all surfaces. Move pinned configs to claude-sonnet-4-6.
Unable to resolve service for type 'X' in ASP.NET Core: read X first, Y second. Three fixes cover almost every case.
Scope validation caught a captive: a singleton just grabbed your scoped DbContext. IServiceScopeFactory fixes it.
